cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lend me your good racket for the final. I taught you that backhand; I'd like to play mine on strings that haven't sagged.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you admit my racket helped?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll thank the strings. The strokes are mine. You've become quite particular about equipment since I stopped lending you everything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Its loose strings would take the blame if I lost. Give me yours so we can see my actual backhand; you remember what it looked like before I taught you yours.

reason: Give the exact Drive a concrete request, relevant pupil habit and responsive B4 development. Improve weak endings into things A actually needs B to do, without changing playable card wording.
